patterns.note: Organic, wave-like section dividers are used to transition between content blocks, creating a soft, flowing visual rhythm that breaks from traditional rectangular layouts.
A highly decorative, bold serif font is used for prominent headings and key statements, creating an emotional and editorial feel, contrasting with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.
A vibrant, warm pink/red is used as a primary accent and background color for key text sections, creating a distinctive and memorable brand presence.
A large, wave-shaped content block scrolls up from the bottom, progressively covering a full-bleed video hero and revealing primary text content with a smooth, fluid transition.
Image galleries are presented in a consistent grid layout with generous padding, often featuring high-quality food or interior shots to convey atmosphere and quality.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background video that plays continuously, serving as an atmospheric backdrop. A large, wave-shaped content container with a solid background color is positioned to scroll over the hero video, creating a dynamic reveal effect as the user scrolls down the page, progressively covering the video content.
The site uses a combination of a decorative display font for emotional impact and a clean sans-serif for readability, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy.
Image grids are used to showcase visual content, with consistent spacing and often a subtle border or shadow to define each image.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, decorative headings are used for emotional impact and brand identity, often in a vibrant red, while body text is smaller, highly readable, and set in a clean sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners for images and containers, but a prominent organic, soft curve defines the wave-like section dividers, adding a unique fluidity.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and consistent padding within image grids, creating an airy yet structured feel.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the prominent, organic wave-shaped section divider that scrolls up to reveal content over a full-bleed video hero. This creates a unique, flowing visual transition and a strong brand identity, moving beyond typical rectangular section breaks to evoke a sense of elegance and fluidity.
